notes: Units: seconds from time zero; bus numbers start at 1. Model semantics is explicit. At equal timestamps, mandatory arrivals and completions precede listed manual actions, then one automatic decision batch, then door starts and departures. Cutoff includes arrivals at that timestamp, cancels later demand and ends new automatic decisions. The temporal control window is start inclusive, end exclusive; its automatic components restore normal service at end. Manual bounded instructions may finish or expire during drain. Cohort includes all present just before its boundary plus births through cutoff, retaining original whole-journey clocks. ordered-v3 until_recovered uses forward gap at most 110% of ideal; a convoy leader owns the long wrap arc. Stopping precedes overhead and sequential door service; both overlap holds. Starting extends the following travel segment after service/holds. True bypasses incur neither stopping nor starting penalties. Missing maneuver fields in older v3 recipes mean zero. A boarding_limit permits the specified number of new boardings per visit; existing boarding finishes. See scenario-guide.html for bounds and definitions.
name: Balanced · fixed arrivals
description: 12 stops, 4 buses, 40-second segments, fixed arrivals at 3 passengers per stop per minute, four-stop rides, and 5-second stopping and starting delays. Buses begin evenly spaced; no disruption or automatic control. Run this baseline, then add a hold or load a disruption lesson. The maneuver penalties are paid at served stops, including empty ones; true bypasses avoid both.

model.calibration_notes: Illustrative teaching model; not empirically calibrated.
